// # Skeletal animation
//
// The rig and the data bound to it: bones, skeletons, poses, skin weights,
// morph targets, sockets, and skeletal clips. Bones form a forest addressed by
// index into the owning skeleton's bone array; -1 is the "no bone" sentinel
// throughout. Poses are local: each bone's pose is expressed relative to its
// parent (roots relative to the model).

// A zero-based index of a bone within the owning skeleton's bone array.
// -1 means "no bone".
type BoneIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex

    Value: Integer;
}
